description: Manual payments and refunds record the acting user (R0-PL-07). Run from apps/server against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL, with dist/main.js built for the journey: npx vitest run test/payments-actor.integration.test.ts test/revenue-authorization.integration.test.ts test/release0-journey.integration.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/payments-actor.json --report <report>. Required: every payments-actor case, RA-G5-01 and RA-G5-05 (recordedBy is never public), and the four release0-journey step-4 cases that carry the LEDGER claim (the first payment on a fresh tenant recorded with exactly one Payment row, one Payment row and one Payment:<id>:payment_recorded posting per payment, a duplicate submit absorbed, the remainder posted). R0-16-PROOF-BINDING retitled the step-4 'FIRST FAILING STEP' case to the behaviour it proves (the first payment on a fresh tenant is recorded 201 with exactly one Payment row) and removed the harness recovery case, so this manifest now also requires that first-payment case; the rest of the journey belongs to release0-journey.json. The three suites are declared in `suites` (the journey with needsDist, since it spawns dist/main.js), so scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs runs and judges this manifest with every other one; requireReportSuccess rejects the verdict if any case of the three suites fails. allowAdditionalCases is true for those journey cases and the two pre-existing revenue-authorization it.todo records (RA-G4-13, RA-G16-01). The two R0-11 review gaps PA-17 (ST-R011-2, refunding an unposted payment recorded no refunder) and PA-18 (ST-R011-3, drive-intake approval dropped the approver) are closed by R0-CMF2-PAYMENT-ACTOR-GAPS: their it.todo records are replaced by the required cases PA-17a..PA-17e (every manual refund, posted or not, writes exactly one FINANCE payment_refunded activity row naming the refunder, USER for a person, SYSTEM for KEY, none for a caller with no actor; no ledger row is invented for an unposted payment and Payment.recordedBy keeps the recorder; the row is written with the refund transaction client, so it commits with the refund, a refund that rolls back leaves none and a refused one adds none; the contact-event registry has no refund type, so the audit row is the unified activity row the posted-refund path already wrote) and PA-18a..PA-18b (POST /drive/businesses/:b/intake/:id/approve records the approver as Payment.recordedBy, the posting createdById and the contact event actor, ignoring any recorder named in the plan payload; the ingestion auto-execute, with no human, records null, so PA-08 holds). The R0-CMF2 review repairs add the required cases PA-17f..PA-17g and PA-18c..PA-18d: the refund audit row is no longer handed to the best-effort TimelineService (which swallows every error), so a failing timeline cannot drop it and a refund whose audit insert fails rolls back (500) instead of committing a REFUNDED payment that names nobody (SEC-CMF2-1, CR-CMF2-1); and the drive-intake record_payment step passes idempotencyKey drive:<intakeFileId>:<actionIndex>, so two concurrent approvals of one intake, or a re-run after a crash before the approved flip, record one payment, not two (SEC-CMF2-2). allowAdditionalCases also covers the R0-CMF2 it.todo record PA-18e, fixed only outside that packet's write set: the drive-intake approve route requires no revenue:write, so a revenue:read or crm:read-only STAFF member can record a payment through it (SEC-CMF2-3, needs a module-scope requirement on drive-intake.controller.ts). PA-16 (ST-R011-1, a human PATCH of invoice status PAID attributed to KEY) is closed by R0-CMF1-INVOICE-PATCH-ACTOR: its it.todo is replaced by the required cases PA-16a..PA-16j (PAID, SENT, OVERDUE and VOID through PATCH .../invoices/:id name the human; the body is the whitelisted UpdateInvoiceDto and the service is handed the authenticated user; an invalid status is a 400; a revenue:read member is refused 403 like the dedicated mark-paid route, whose authority PATCH status PAID now requires; the owner's PATCH and mark-paid ledger effects are identical; KEY's flow-executor call and an explicit KEY actor stay attributed to KEY). The R0-CMF1 review repairs add the required cases PA-16k..PA-16m: the service itself refuses a status outside SENT / OVERDUE / VOID / PAID before anything is written, so KEY's commerce_update_invoice can no longer move an invoice to PARTIALLY_PAID, PENDING or FAILED (SEC-CMF1-1); the invoice write routes (PATCH .../invoices/:id, mark-paid, payment-failed, the status route) answer with the contact projected to id, businessId, firstName, lastName and email (SEC-CMF1-2); and KEY's invoice.paid / invoice.sent / invoice.overdue / invoice.void entries are labelled SYSTEM (SEC-CMF1-4). allowAdditionalCases also covers the two R0-CMF1 it.todo records PA-16n and PA-16o, fixed only outside that packet's write set: an omitted actor still means KEY until flow-orchestrator passes KEY explicitly (SEC-CMF1-3), and the ACCRUAL invoice_finalized posting and its void reversal record no creator (SEC-CMF1-5). Until PA-16n and PA-16o are closed, 'the system actor is distinct from a human' is proven only on the paths PA-06, PA-07, PA-14, PA-16a..m, PA-17e and PA-18a..d cover. V1-41-DM-UNTRUSTED-MONEY-INPUTS (M32, owner ruling D-27) records an evidence-extracted or Drive-intake payment PENDING: PA-07, PA-14, PA-18b and PA-18c are retitled and PA-18a and PA-18d keep their titles: the extracted row keeps its recorder (KEY, the approver, or null with no human) and nothing is posted until a member with revenue:write confirms it through PaymentEvidenceService.confirmPendingPayment, which records the money through recordPayment as that member (the posting and the contact event name the confirming member); the Drive step's key keeps one row per step. The V1-41 review repairs (AUD-V41-3, CR-V41-2) replace the it.todo record PA-14b with the required case PA-14b: PaymentEvidenceService.recordPendingPayment writes, in the same transaction as the PENDING row, one COMMERCE payment_pending_recorded activities row naming the recorder (KEY as SYSTEM) and, beside KEY only, the uploader taken from req.user as data.initiatedBy (never the body's), and the row stays after a member confirms the payment (the contact-event registry has no pending-payment type, so, as for the R0-CMF2 refund audit row, the audit row is the unified activities row). W7-DRIVE-INTAKE-SCOPE closes PA-18e (SEC-CMF2-3) with the required cases PA-18e..f (the drive approve route needs revenue:write; D-46 refuses a non-member SUPER_ADMIN), and its review repairs add PA-18g..i: the data-inbox approve route, which runs the same plan, is held to the same rule because DriveIntakeOrchestrator.executePlan checks the approver itself (SEC-W7DI-1); the reject route needs revenue:write and never relabels an approved intake (SEC-W7DI-2); the intake list needs revenue:read and clamps its limit (SEC-W7DI-3).
